frozen_before: any LacunaNet code, training, or v4 test download
hardware: Intel Core i9-9880H (8C/16T), 16 GB, macOS, CPU only (no GPU at any stage)

architecture.inputs: inner anchors A-1, A+1; optional outer A-2, A+2 with masks; anchor times; target t; log2 gap
architecture.motion: 3-level coarse-to-fine target->inner flows, outer-anchor context, FiLM conditioning
architecture.synthesis: backward warp + occlusion mask + small U-Net residual

data.gopro_train: GOPRO_Large train sharp, 22 scenes, 2103 frames, 640x360, gaps 1-16, outer anchors p=0.8
data.vimeo_train: bijinc/vimeo-90k-medium train (25,656 triplets, ~50% official), streamed per shard

training.loss: Charbonnier + 0.1*LPIPS-alex + Laplace NLL (stop-grad residual into scale)
training.selection: dev SNU YouTube T3: scene-mean PSNR - 20*LPIPS

size_rule: largest C with 640x360 ORT CPU latency (2 threads, warm, median of 20) <= RIFE 4.9 under identical conditions

eval_sets.xiph_c_rules: centred 48-frame window, stride 2 for >=50 fps, v3 cut rule, min 6 clips

gates.G8: Xiph-C T3: LacunaNet - RIFE4.9 PSNR paired CI lower > 0 AND mean LPIPS diff <= 0
gates.G10: Vimeo test and each SNU-FILM level: no baseline both faster and higher PSNR than LacunaNet
gates.G11: self-error per-frame Spearman >= 0.6 on Xiph-C AND conformal coverage >= 0.88 in every gated stratum
